description: Make an @element in a space from images, a video or a voice you sent there, so every image and video made in the space and its sub-spaces keeps that character, product or place the same when a prompt names @name. Send each file with upload_file and space_id first. The answer has the element_id.

description.description: Who or what it is, in a line a prompt can lean on.

media_ids.description: media_id values from upload_file's answers with space_id, or from list_elements: up to 4 images (the first is the face) or one video instead, plus one voice or sound. A video runs at least 3 s and audio at least 5 s; a model uses the first seconds it takes of a longer one.

name.description: What a prompt calls it after @: letters, digits and _, with a letter, up to 30.

name: create_element
title: Create element
